changelog:
Home Sidebar Menu—slide-out panel from screen edge. Swipe left or right to access voice messages, browser, weather, clock, quick entities, camera, mic mute. Voice status at top, Settings at bottom. Enable in Device Services → Sidebar Settings. Each item toggles individually. Works instantly without restart.

Wake Visual Feedback upgraded. Colorful ripple on wake, expanding from screen center. Full-screen edge glow during conversation—listens with your voice, pulses when speaking. Two wake words get different colors: green and cyan. Looks good even on old devices.

Wake-Word Engine improved. microWakeWord and vsWakeWord now remember their own settings separately. Switching engines no longer erases your choices. Home Assistant wake words sync correctly. New stop word ok_stop under VS engine. Built-in models: ok_nabu, hey_jarvis, ok_stop.

microWakeWord: tiny 50KB, fast, light on battery, best for old Android 7 devices. vsWakeWord: larger 500KB, stronger noise rejection, better for busy rooms. Pick what fits your hardware.
